payload.title: A site replaces the agents' role instructions
payload.description:
The built-in reporter, copywriter, editor and illustrator text assumes evidence-first news and can only be added to.

```gherkin
Feature: Role instructions are site data

  Scenario: The site's text is the only text
    Given a site whose copywriter instructions describe satire
    When the copywriter agent is given a Story
    Then its instructions contain the site's text
    And they contain no built-in news wording
```

**Needs Papyrus work:** PPY-7a61ca; guidelines epic PPY-2a2a8a.
